operating_notes.text: Organon reported CY2025 revenue of US$ 6,215 million.
Proposed acquisition of Organon & Co. for an enterprise value of US$ 11.75 billion, funded via US$ 2-2.5 billion cash and US$ 9.25-9.75 billion debt.
Organon brings 50 established brands, including 15 generating over $100 million in sales, and a global commercial footprint across 140 countries.
India formulation sales grew 14% in FY26 to ₹192,904 million, accounting for 33.2% of total consolidated sales.
Innovative Medicines crossed $1 billion in sales in the United States for the first time in FY26.
India formulations grew 16% to ₹5,475 Cr in Q1FY27, 36.1% of consolidated sales.
US sales fell 9.7% to USD 427 million, 26.6% of consolidated sales, on Lenalidomide erosion.
Global Innovative Medicines sales rose 12.8% to USD 351 million, 21.9% of sales.
UNLOXCYT received a Category 2A preferred designation in the NCCN Guidelines for laCSCC patients.
US FDA approved sBLA for ILUMYA (tildrakizumab-asmn) for active psoriatic arthritis based on INSPIRE-1 and INSPIRE-2 trials.

timeline.summary: Sun Pharma incorporated a wholly owned US subsidiary named Sun Pharma America, Inc. on 23 April 2026.
Sun Pharma entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Organon & Co. for an enterprise value of US$ 11.75 billion in an all-cash transaction.
Sun Pharma scheduled an investor call for 27 April 2026 to discuss updates on the Organon & Co. acquisition.
2026-04-27: Sun Pharma posts the audio recording of the investor call on the acquisition of Organon & Co.
Sun Pharma posted the transcript of the investor call held on 27 April 2026 regarding the acquisition of Organon & Co. for US$ 11.75 billion.
2026-05-07: CRISIL places Sun Pharma's long-term bank facilities rating on watch with developing implications following the Organon acquisition announcement.
On 08 May 2026, Sun Pharma announced the completion of its postal ballot and the appointment of Ms. Satyavati Berera as an Independent Director.
Dilip S. Shanghvi, Promoter of Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited, declared no new encumbrances on shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI regulations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹14,611.79 Cr (+12.8% YoY), net profit ₹2,709.66 Cr (+25.8% YoY).
Sun Pharma's board approved promoter group reclassification requests and adopted a revised fair disclosure code effective June 1, 2026.
On 26 May 2026, Sun Pharma submitted an application to stock exchanges for promoter group reclassification under Regulation 31A.
Sun Pharma hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for high single-digit revenue growth in FY27.
Sun Pharma's Q1FY27 call (31 July 2026) reported 10.1% sales growth to ₹15,184 Cr, EBITDA margin of 28.9%, and reiterated high single-digit FY27 growth guidance.
CRISIL and ICRA assigned AAA/Stable ratings to Sun Pharma's proposed ₹15,000 Cr NCD programme on October 13, 2026.
On October 20, 2026, Sun Pharma announced that UNLOXCYT received a Category 2A preferred designation in the updated NCCN Guidelines for laCSCC.
Sun Pharma announced long-term follow-up data for UNLOXCYT in advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma to be presented at ESMO 2026.
US FDA approved sBLA for ILUMYA (tildrakizumab-asmn) for the treatment of adults with active psoriatic arthritis.
Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited shared the FY27-Q2 earnings call recording via sunpharma.com on 30 October 2026, signed by Anoop Anjanikumar Deshpande (Anoop Deshpande).
All special resolutions in the postal ballot notice dated 01 October 2026 were approved by members, effective 31 October 2026.
